metaDescription: Agrisure NK8840 EZ Refuge corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety. 106 to 109 days to harvest, 8.2 t/ha in trials. See its pest ratings and traits.
keywords: Agrisure NK8840 EZ Refuge corn variety
excerpt: Agrisure NK8840 EZ Refuge corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety, also sold or known as NK8840 or NK8840 BGT. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2018 as NSIC 2018 GMCn 49. Syngenta bred it. It takes 106 to 109 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 8.16 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Agrisure NK8840 EZ Refuge corn takes 106 to 109 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 89 yellow GM hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 105.4 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 8.16 t/ha matches the average of its group, 8.13. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives 115 to 120 days after planting (company page), a 2019 company write up said 110 to 115 days, 106 to 109 in NSIC trials.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [Corn rust](/diseases/corn-rust), [Corn stalk rot](/diseases/corn-stalk-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn planthopper](/pests/corn-planthopper). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Its ears grew about 17.1 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 74.6 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears. Against lodging it rated resistant, so it stood up well when wind and rain pushed the plants.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** Potential 12 t/ha on the product page (the Syngenta corn overview page says 13 t/ha), 12.8 t/ha and 12.1 t/ha at the Region 2 derby, NSIC trials averaged 8.77 t/ha (dry season) and 7.56 (wet season).

**Traits in the seed:** BGT stack Bt11 x TC1507 x GA21: two built in proteins against corn borer and other caterpillars, plus glyphosate tolerance (BPI lists the stack as caterpillar resistant and glyphosate and glufosinate tolerant).
**Season:** Wet and dry season.
**Where:** Cagayan Valley (upper vega), Ilocos Region, Central Luzon.
Very big, heavy ears with large kernels (sold as 'jumbo').
Strong stalks.
Better drought tolerance, holds yield under stress.
Stays green late.
Easy to dehusk and harvest by hand.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: top yielder at the DA Region 2 (Cagayan Valley) corn derby in both 2017 and 2019, the first back to back winner (BusinessWorld), the City of Ilagan corn center lists it among the yellow hybrids most grown there. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual corn on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Agrisure NK8840 EZ Refuge corn

The registry recommends it for Luzon and Mindanao. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is NK8840 the same as Agrisure NK8840 EZ Refuge?
items.a: Yes. NK8840 is another name for Agrisure NK8840 EZ Refuge, registered as NSIC 2018 GMCn 49. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 106 to 109 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 8.16 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.
The registry recommends it for Luzon and Mindanao. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Agrisure NK8840 EZ Refuge?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
